Suppose $X$ is an mx1 random vector, $A$ is a fixed k x m matrix, and $\mathcal I$ represents an information set. Recall the definition:


$$
\operatorname{Var}(X\mid\mathcal I)
=
E\left[
(X-E[X\mid\mathcal I])
(X-E[X\mid\mathcal I])^\top
\mid\mathcal I
\right]
$$

Starting from this definition, derive: 

$$
\operatorname{Var}(AX|\mathcal I) = A \operatorname{Var}(X | \mathcal I) A'
$$
